description: Write a value to a GPIO pin on `agent` ('0', '1', 'on', 'off', or 'toggle'). Optional duration in seconds, after which the pin reverts to its previous state. If the pin has a configured 'max' pulse duration, the effective duration is clamped to it - and if no duration is given but 'max' is set, 'max' is used as the duration automatically.
name: mcp_gpio_write
